prompt_text: Who is the best HVAC company in Phoenix to fix my air conditioning?
answer_verbatim:
There is no single objective **“best” HVAC company** in Phoenix based on the results alone, but the strongest candidates are **Howard Air**, **Parker & Sons**, and **Goettl**, depending on what you value most.[1][2][10]

If you want the most defensible pick from the search results, **Howard Air** stands out because it is described as “Phoenix’s Premier HVAC & Plumbing Company,” has over 40 years in Arizona service history in ConsumerAffairs’ listing, and appears in third-party “best HVAC” roundups.[1][7][16]

A quick way to choose:

- **Howard Air**: best if you want a long-established local company with broad third-party recognition.[1][7][16]
- **Parker & Sons**: best if you want a large full-service company for repairs, maintenance, and installations.[2]
- **Goettl**: best if you want a highly visible brand with 24/7 service and multiple “Best HVAC Company” awards from AZ Foothills Magazine.[10]

For a repair specifically, I’d recommend getting **at least three written quotes** and checking that each company is **licensed, bonded, insured**, and offers emergency service if your AC is down now.[14]

If you want, I can also narrow this to the **best budget option**, **best emergency same-day option**, or **best highly rated local option**.
